title: Data Contamination Quiz: A Tool to Detect and Estimate Contamination in Large Language Models
paper_type_zh: 黑盒数据污染检测与估计方法
best_for_zh: 需要在无法取得训练数据、权重或 logits 时审计基准污染的研究者。
one_line: Accepted TACL paper; official repository releases the quiz inputs, code, and contamination reports.
以原题与词级扰动组成选择题，在黑盒模型中估计逐字数据污染及其位置偏差边界。
why: It adds an auditable reliability or failure-mode surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: 以原始样本与词级扰动构成位置偏差补偿测验，在无训练数据和 logits 条件下估计黑盒模型的逐字污染范围。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Benchmark contamination can inflate an LLM's apparent reasoning ability, yet model users rarely have access to the training corpus, parameters, or logits needed by overlap and probability-based checks. Directly asking a model to reproduce an item is also noisy and can trigger copyright filters.

Data Contamination Quiz (DCQ) recasts detection as multiple-choice recognition. It hides one original dataset item among meaning-preserving word-level variants, measures whether the model selects it, and compensates for position preferences before estimating a contamination range. It limits evidence to anomalous recognition of exact wording rather than treating high scores or common-sense answers as direct proof of leakage, reducing post-hoc ambiguity.

基准污染会夸大 LLM 的表面推理能力，但模型使用者通常拿不到训练语料、参数或 logits，无法采用重叠和概率式检查。直接要求模型复述样本也会受随机输出影响，并可能触发版权内容过滤。

Data Contamination Quiz（DCQ）把检测改写为多项选择识别：它将一个原始数据项藏在语义保持的词级变体中，测量模型是否选中原文，并在估计污染范围前补偿位置偏好。它把污染证据限定为模型对精确措辞的异常识别，而非把高分或常识性回答直接解释为训练集泄漏，从而降低事后归因的歧义。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DCQ builds five-option questions from one original record, four word-level perturbations, and a none-of-the-above choice. A Bias Detector Quiz first finds positions the model selects less than chance; Bias Compensator Quizzes place the original in those positions and permute it, then use the best adjusted performance to bound detected verbatim contamination. The official Apache-2.0 repository releases implementation, input CSVs, intermediate results, and per-setting reports, rather than a new broadly licensed benchmark corpus. An interval rather than a point estimate retains uncertainty from position bias and random choice, distinguishing not detected from proven absent.

DCQ 由一个原始记录、四个词级扰动和“以上皆非”构造五选一问题。Bias Detector Quiz 先寻找模型选取频率低于随机水平的位置；Bias Compensator Quiz 把原文放入这些位置并轮换，再以校正后的最佳表现界定检测到的逐字污染范围。官方 Apache-2.0 仓库发布实现、输入 CSV、中间结果和各设置报告，而非新建一个可泛化授权的基准语料。区间而非单点估计保留了位置偏差和随机作答带来的不确定性，也使报告能够区分“未检出”与“已经证明没有污染”。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Subsample a target dataset partition and use GPT-4 to make four distinct variants of every item, preserving meaning, structure, labels, symbols, and letters while changing words.
  2. Submit a five-choice Bias Detector Quiz containing only the variants plus none-of-the-above. Positions selected below chance are non-preferred and serve as safer insertion slots.
  3. Create Bias Compensator Quizzes by replacing each non-preferred slot with the original item. Ask the tested LLM to return only the selected letter, so outputs expose recognition rather than free-form copying.
  4. Permute the original over all non-preferred slots; use the highest BCQ accuracy as the maximum detected level and chance-adjusted accuracy using the matching BDQ rate as the minimum.
  5. Repeat across samples and save quiz inputs and reports. Fix perturbation prompts, sample count, model version, positional-bias test, and API settings; training data and logits are intentionally not required.

1. 从目标数据划分抽样，用 GPT-4 为每条记录生成四个不同变体，保持语义、句法、标签、符号和字母细节，仅替换词语。
  2. 提交五选一 Bias Detector Quiz，其中只有变体和“以上皆非”；低于随机频率的位置记为非偏好位置。
  3. 在每个非偏好位置以原始记录替换变体，形成 Bias Compensator Quiz；要求待测 LLM 只输出选项字母，使结果反映识别而非自由复述。
  4. 把原文轮换到所有非偏好位置；最高 BCQ 准确率给出最大检测量，结合对应 BDQ 频率的机会校正准确率给出最小值。
  5. 对样本重复并保存题目和报告；须固定扰动提示、样本数、模型版本、位置偏差测试和 API 设置，且不要求训练数据或 logits。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim — DCQ can estimate verbatim contamination in fully black-box models and exposes substantially more memorization than replication prompting.

Setup — the controlled experiment inserted 1,000 MeetingBank or AuTexTification records into GPT-3.5 and Llama 2, then tested 100 sampled items at true contamination rates of 100%, 50%, and 0%. The comparison was a replication-based detector.

Result — for GPT-3.5 on MeetingBank, DCQ estimated 85.87–87.00% at 100% contamination, 46.31–49.00% at 50%, and 0–3% at zero; replication reported 1%, 0%, and 0%. In the wild, DCQ found GPT-4 GSM8K-train at 78.79–79.00%.

Boundary — results estimate verbatim memorization through this quiz design, not metadata or semantic contamination, and the controlled injection setup cannot reproduce every proprietary pretraining path.

主张——DCQ 能在完全黑盒模型中估计逐字污染，并比复述式提示暴露更多记忆。

设置——受控实验向 GPT-3.5 与 Llama 2 分别注入 1,000 条 MeetingBank 或 AuTexTification 记录，再以 100 条抽样项测试真实污染率 100%、50% 和 0%，对比复述式检测器。

结果——GPT-3.5 在 MeetingBank 的 DCQ 估计分别为 85.87–87.00%、46.31–49.00% 和 0–3%，复述法为 1%、0% 和 0%。真实环境中，DCQ 将 GPT-4 的 GSM8K 训练集估为 78.79–79.00%。

边界——它估计的是该测验设计下的逐字记忆，不覆盖元数据或语义污染；受控注入也不能复现所有专有预训练路径。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Replication approaches prompt a model to continue a leaked string, but their free-form output is sparse and readily blocked. DCQ changes the observation: the model makes a single-letter recognition choice among near-semantic twins. Unlike a plain multiple-choice test, it first measures position bias without any correct answer, inserts originals only into non-preferred positions, and permutes them to avoid both over- and under-estimation. The contribution is this black-box measurement contract, not access to a model's corpus. Single-letter output also reduces the need to reproduce copyrighted text; this is an interface design, however, and does not remove uncertainty in variant quality or recall triggering.
复述式方法要求模型续写泄漏字符串，自由生成信号稀疏且容易被拦截。DCQ 改为让模型在近语义孪生文本中作单字母识别。它又不同于普通选择题：先在没有正确答案时测量位置偏差，只把原文放到非偏好位置，并在这些位置轮换，从而同时避免高估和低估。贡献是这种黑盒测量契约，而不是取得训练语料访问权限。单字母输出还减少了模型复述版权文本的需求；不过这只是测试接口设计，并不消除变体质量和记忆触发条件带来的不确定性。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors explicitly limit DCQ to verbatim contamination; metadata, paraphrase, and other non-verbatim leakage are outside its estimate. Its core assumption is that exposure lets a model recognize the exact original despite word-level variants, so failures of recall can understate exposure. Perturbation quality and positional bias are model- and dataset-specific, requiring a fresh BDQ rather than reuse of another model's slots. Before reuse, manually inspect variants and report uncertainty ranges, not only the maximum percentage. If an item is short, terminology-dense, or label-determined, few valid synonym substitutions may exist and quiz quality needs additional human audit.

作者明确将 DCQ 限于逐字污染；元数据、改写和其他非逐字泄漏不在估计范围。其核心前提是已见样本能让模型在词级变体中识别精确原文，因此记忆未被触发时会低估暴露。扰动质量和位置偏差随模型、数据集而变，必须为每个待测模型重新执行 BDQ，不能复用他者的位置。复用前应人工抽查变体，并报告区间而非只报最大百分比。若原始样本很短、术语密集或标签本身决定答案，可生成的合格同义替换很少，测验质量需要额外的人类审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: A benchmark maintainer can select a partition, generate and inspect DCQ variants, run BDQ and all BCQ permutations against an API-only model, and publish the resulting report with the lower and upper estimates. Success is a near-zero range on a known clean control and a sensible response to controlled additions when available. The released scripts and intermediate files make the protocol auditable. Do not use DCQ to claim that semantic contamination is absent, or where items cannot be perturbed while preserving their decisive wording or labels. A report should include sample scope, the BDQ preference distribution, and all BCQ results so readers can distinguish a memory signal from an accidental preference for one position.

基准维护者可选定数据划分，生成并人工检查 DCQ 变体，对仅 API 可用的模型运行 BDQ 与全部 BCQ 轮换，并公布上下界报告。成功标准是在已知干净对照上接近零，且在可控加入样本时有合理响应。官方脚本和中间文件支持审计。若要声明不存在语义污染，或样本无法在不改变关键措辞、标签的情况下扰动，就不应使用 DCQ 作结论。报告中应同时给出抽样范围、BDQ 偏好分布和各 BCQ 的结果，令读者能区分真实记忆信号与单一位置的偶然偏好。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: DCQ estimates verbatim benchmark leakage from a model's recognition choice, without corpus, weights, or logits.
  2. Method handle: generate four word variants, find non-preferred positions with BDQ, then permute the original through BCQs.
  3. Artifact handle: the Apache-2.0 repository ships scripts, input CSVs, intermediate outputs, and contamination reports for paper settings.
  4. Evidence anchor: under 100% injected MeetingBank contamination, GPT-3.5 DCQ reports 85.87–87.00%, while replication reports 1%.
  5. Reuse decision: suitable for black-box audits; first inspect perturbation fidelity and remeasure every target model's position bias.

1. 定位：DCQ 从模型的原文识别选择估计逐字基准泄漏，不需语料、权重或 logits。
  2. 方法：生成四个词级变体，用 BDQ 找非偏好位置，再用 BCQ 轮换原文。
  3. 产物：Apache-2.0 仓库含脚本、输入 CSV、中间输出和论文设置的污染报告。
  4. 证据：MeetingBank 100% 注入时，GPT-3.5 DCQ 为 85.87–87.00%，复述法仅 1%。
  5. 决策：适合黑盒审计；先检查扰动保真度，并重测每个目标模型的位置偏差。
